text:
maya: quick FYI
sampleapp rerank surfaced corrupted embeddings after a retry path yesterday
kevin: what do you mean by corrupted? length mismatch? 
maya: yes. expected 1024 but some items became 1536 when retries merged responses
sam: any logs or repro? 
maya: minimal repro from local run:
```
2026-03-22T10:02:11Z batch=bb-12 attempt=1 POST /v1/embeddings ids=6 dim=1024 -> 200
2026-03-22T10:02:12Z batch=bb-12 attempt=2 POST /v1/embeddings ids=6 dim=512 -> 200
client-merge -> item[4] length=1536
```
kevin: that smells like two things: routing gave a different model for the retry (512) and the client merge concatenated partials instead of replacing
maya: nailed it. node sampleapp batcher had this merge helper:
```
function mergeResponses(base, partial){
  return base.map((b,i)=> partial[i]? b.concat(partial[i]) : b);
}
```
alex: concat is incorrect unless server returns segments intentionally. python helper throws on dim mismatch, so parity gap here
sam: also observed headers differed across attempts in the trace. first attempt had `x-request-group`+`x-batch-id`, retry only had `x-batch-id` so SmartRouting sent a cheaper variant
kevin: fixes we should push: 1) change merge to replace, not concat; 2) validate dims and throw on mismatch; 3) preserve idempotency/routing headers across retries (`x-batch-id`, `x-request-group`, Idempotency-Key)
maya: pushed a tiny hotfix to sampleapp that rejects dim mismatches and logs shapes instead of concatenating. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/pull/900
sam: i'll add a parity unit that injects a mismatched partial and asserts the client errors. also add an e2e that stubs SmartRouting to return two variants across attempts
ci-bot: triggered -> devex/embed-batcher-parity-check started
kevin: docs: add onboarding note about canonical response keys (`embedding` vs `embeddings`) and include the small snippet to validate dims:
```
if (embedding.length !== expectedDim) throw new Error(`dim mismatch: got ${embedding.length}`)
```
alex: changelog entry needed since this is breaking for anyone who relied on concat semantics: "embedding-batcher: strict-replace-on-retry, dim validation"
maya: follow-ups assigned: sam (tests/e2e), maya (hotfix + docs), alex (changelog). ETA EOD tomorrow
kevin: thanks all :thumbsup:
